key_features: Take one hassle out of back to school shopping with a School Supply Box filled with everything your elementary student needs. This supply kit contains (1) plastic pencil box, (1) 10pk of Markers, (1) 24pk of Crayons, (1) 12pk of colored pencils, and (3) glue sticks.

Additionally, the box contains (10) #2 pencils, (5) pencil top erasers, (1) rubber eraser, (1) pencil sharpener, (1) pair of blunt tip scissors, (2) pencil grips, (1) standard 12 inch ruler, (1) wide-rule spiral notebook, (1) wide ruled composition book, and (2) 2-pocket folder with metal prongs.
The art supplies in this school supply box are great for your young artist to use on art projects, map projects, coloring pages, coloring books, assignments, or for making holiday decorations.
This massive school supply kit contains everything your child in kindergarten, first grade, second grade, third grade, fourth grade, or fifth grade could need for the first day of school.

School Supply Boxes don't have to just be for school kids. The supply kits also make a great gift for a teacher, substitute teacher, principal, vice principal, tutor, guidance counselor, or for a homeschooled child.
review_summary: Every parent has experienced the frustration of buying school supplies. Crowds and limited supplies at box stores can make it impossible to find everything on your child's school supply list quickly. Shopping early might help, but who wants to shop for school supplies in July? And if you’re one of those last minute shoppers, you often have to take what you can find no matter if it might not be the best quality. We saw this and thought there had to be a better way.
pros: Eliminates the hassle and stress of in-store back-to-school shopping
Comprehensive 32-piece set covers almost all standard K-5 supply lists
Excellent value and convenience for under $30
cons: May not satisfy teacher lists requiring hyper-specific brand names
Color variations for folders and notebooks are non-customizable
